build: HEAD 9d9e36c plus the uncommitted Wave 1a and Wave 2 tree; .opencode/plugin/tawassul.js (2052555 bytes, 16147 description bytes) copied into each isolated workspace
method: Four isolated stages under /tmp/opencode/w2-live/roots/<stage>: one workspace per stage with .opencode/plugin/tawassul.js, two roster agents, a symlinked .opencode/node_modules, and XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, TAWASSUL_HMAC_KEY_DIR and OPENCODE_DB redirected under the same root. Each prompt ran the installed host with --standalone --auto --format json --agent dev --model opencode/big-pickle. Retries are recomputed from the run.out transcript: a retry is an error tool_use followed by another call of the same tool in the same session, the same rule rankToolRuns applies to .opencode/tool-run-log.json.
pacingRule: Every retained stage prompt required one tool call per message and a wait for each result. The rule removes two harness artifacts that are unrelated to description text: parallel tool calls that trip the plugin burst guard, and the model guessing a path outside the isolated workspace.

discarded.name: goal-review
discarded.reason: The model issued two goal calls in one message; the plugin burst guard (BURST_MAX 3 per BURST_WINDOW_MS 1000) rejected the second. The error is a guard denial, not a description fault, and the receipt keeps the paced rerun.
discarded.error: Rate limit (burst) exceeded for dev:nvidia:deepseek-ai. Active bursts: 3/3

discarded.name: diagnostics
discarded.reason: The prompt named package.json but the isolated workspace root carries none, so the model read a path outside the workspace and then gave up. The workspace now seeds notes.md and the retained run reads it.

discarded.name: diagnostics
discarded.reason: Same missing package.json with an explicit relative path; the model reported the miss once and issued no second read.

discarded.name: context-continue
discarded.reason: Two provider outages before the retained run: the host resolved the route to nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash and the provider answered provider.no-route before any tool call completed.

disclosure: Across the retained stages the top eight hot tools keep the frozen zero-retry baseline (0 to 0). Two discarded runs carry one retry each: a plugin burst-guard denial and a model path guess outside the workspace. Neither retry follows from a description edit, and both are reported here rather than dropped.
notes: The tool-run-log flush lags the transcript: goal-review logged 12 of 13 calls, handoff-triage 5 of 6, context-continue 13 of 14, and diagnostics logged nothing because the run ended before a state save. Retry counts therefore come from run.out, which carries every tool_use with state.status.
The host reports the shell tool as shell in the transcript and the plugin records it as bash in the run log; both are folded into the bash row.
The model route resolved to nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash in every stage despite --model opencode/big-pickle, the same routing defect E1 recorded.
